categories.main_business_segments: SK bioscience Co., Ltd. primarily operates in vaccine and biopharmaceutical research, development, production, sales, and CDMO/CMO services. The company focuses on developing and manufacturing vaccines for infectious diseases and expanding into new bio areas such as cell and gene therapies. It also engages in contract development and manufacturing for global pharmaceutical partners.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced vaccine production platforms including cell culture-based vaccine manufacturing, recombinant protein technology, and viral vector platforms. It has proprietary technologies for producing cell-cultured influenza vaccines, recombinant protein COVID-19 vaccines, and conjugate vaccines. SK bioscience also employs single-use systems and cGMP-compliant facilities to ensure high-quality vaccine production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government health agencies, hospitals, clinics, international organizations (e.g., WHO, UNICEF), and global pharmaceutical companies. The company serves domestic and international markets, supplying vaccines for national immunization programs and global public health initiatives, especially in developing countries. It also supports pharmaceutical companies through CDMO/CMO services.
categories.geographic_coverage: SK bioscience operates primarily in South Korea with production facilities in Andong, Pyeongtaek, Hwaseong, and headquarters in Pangyo. It exports vaccines globally, including to Southeast Asia, Europe, and the Americas. The company has partnerships and supply agreements with international organizations and governments worldwide, and is expanding its global footprint through strategic collaborations and licensing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the vaccine supply chain, encompassing vaccine R&D, manufacturing, and sales. It also functions as a CDMO/CMO provider, offering contract development and manufacturing services to other pharmaceutical companies, thus playing a critical role in vaccine production and supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the vaccine portfolio with next-generation vaccines such as pneumococcal and universal COVID-19 vaccines, strengthening manufacturing and R&D infrastructure, and enhancing global production capabilities. The company invests heavily in mRNA vaccine platform development and new bio areas like cell and gene therapies. It pursues global partnerships, inorganic growth through M&A, and digital and ESG initiatives to become a top 10 global vaccine company.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through direct sales of proprietary vaccines, contract manufacturing and development services (CDMO/CMO), and licensing agreements. The sales mix in 2023 was approximately 29% from own vaccine products, 65% from CDMO/CMO services, and 6% from other sources. The company also earns revenue from government tenders and exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SK bioscience competes with global vaccine leaders such as GSK, Sanofi, Merck, and Pfizer, which dominate approximately 64% of the global vaccine market. Domestically, it holds leading market shares in influenza, shingles, and varicella vaccines. The company differentiates itself through advanced cell culture technologies, strategic global partnerships, and a growing premium vaccine portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, SK bioscience reported revenues of approximately KRW 369.5 billion, reflecting a 19% decrease from the previous year due to COVID-19 endemic transition impacts. The company has total assets of about KRW 1.85 trillion and equity of KRW 1.7 trillion. Despite recent profit declines, it maintains strong credit ratings (A+ for bonds) and is investing heavily in R&D and facility expansion to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SK bioscience offers high-quality vaccines produced with cutting-edge cell culture and recombinant technologies, enabling rapid response to emerging infectious diseases. Its competitive advantages include proprietary vaccine platforms, WHO prequalification certifications, and a robust global network for vaccine supply. The company emphasizes flexible manufacturing capabilities, premium vaccine development, and strategic collaborations to deliver innovative and reliable vaccines worldwide.
